question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: sometimes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• No time means very soon, or very quickly.
 
• Sometimes means on some occasions but not always or often.
 
• All times means continuously, without interruption
 
• Any time means a point in time which is not fixed or set.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words sometimes is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 2.
